capabilities: Register spl (and splunk alias) as a fenced-code language
Highlight SPL commands, keywords, functions, macros, fields, and literals
Color tokens via the theme's code variables in editing and reading modes
Ship example SPL template files for learning and reuse
extras: Highlight-only by design: it never executes queries, makes network requests, or renders HTML itself. Plain search terms and field names are intentionally left unstyled.
problem: Obsidian's code blocks do not recognize Splunk SPL, so queries in notes appear as plain, uncolored text.
summary: Syntax highlighter that renders Splunk SPL queries in fenced code blocks using Obsidian's native code-block pipeline.
